integrity: The theorem is supported by a stated all-size clade-normal-form argument and depth induction, with a separate bounded full-diagram checker. Earlier Sackin extremal values are credited to the tree-index literature; no independent mathematical audit has occurred.
limitations: The claim concerns ordered distinct pairs in the definable positive upward cone over a finite named antichain, not all parameter graphs, all pair positions, or all tuple arities. The channel spectrum determines the Sackin value but not the whole labelled topology. Historical priority cannot be proven from finite searches.
title: Upward-cone pair types detect Sackin balance in the universal homogeneous binary tree
